explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/582 (Erdős–Hajnal, solved by Folkman): is there a K₄-free graph such that every 2-colouring of its edges has a monochromatic K₃? EdgeRamseyTriangle requires a triangle u, v, w (distinct, by adjacency) with all three edge colours equal, for every colouring c : edgeSet → Fin 2. The statement asserts a finite K₄-free graph with this property. Faithful.
